<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/chat/people"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every other member with whom you currently share at least one
family, sorted by name then id. The check is live: people disappear as
soon as no shared family remains. No email addresses are returned.
This route requires server feature `directMessages`.
